instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a Verilog module that combines a 3-bit up/down counter with a 4-bit binary adder. The counter should count up or down based on a control input and should have a synchronous reset. The adder should take in the output of the counter and an input value, and output the sum. The module should also include a control logic module that enables either the counter or the adder based on a select input. The counter should be triggered on the positive edge of the clock and should be able to pause its count when an external input is asserted.
label: clean
